title: L Viegas
description:
Set on a hillside of the Serra da Estrela mountain range, at approximately 800 meters above sea level, this project is defined by an intense and carefully controlled relationship with the surrounding landscape. Located within a rural property near the village of Pai Viegas, the site is characterized by a continuous and dominant visual presence in all directions.

The implantation strategy originates from the reuse of an existing stone warehouse located at the edge of the property. This pre-existing structure assumes a pivotal role within the project, acting as a hinge between the social and private areas while embodying both functional logic and symbolic presence.

From this anchoring element, the house unfolds into two pure, white volumes arranged in an L-shaped configuration, giving rise to a semi-enclosed courtyard. Rather than explicitly highlighting the existing structure, this intermediate space is inherently defined and enriched by its presence.

The architectural approach adopts a deliberately restrained stance toward the landscape. The house remains largely closed, opening only on a single, carefully oriented façade. The surrounding views are revealed gradually from within the interior spaces, while the courtyard is experienced fully only once one exits the house.

This controlled relationship with the landscape introduces multiple modes of spatial experience, transforming the overwhelming beauty of the site into a sequence of discovery. Architecture thus becomes a mediating instrument between the inhabitant and a territory of exceptional intensity.
